text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Trainer, how was it!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
My gallant form dashing through the Derby! 
Pretty exciting, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I really wanted to flash a 
double-crown peace sign in the winner's 
circle, you know~?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to stand alongside Symboli Rudolf, 
her goal, Tokai Teio's frustration began 
to show.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Come on, don't make such a gloomy face!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"It's true that I couldn't become a Triple 
Crown Umamusume, and part of me's like, 
'Dammit!' but..."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even if I look down, the Prez won't be 
there! The Prez is up ahead of me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"So I've got to reset my mindset for the 
next race! All that's left is the final 
leg of the Classics..."
choice_data_list:
Let's give the Kikuka Sho everything we've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Starting tomorrow, I'll give it my 
all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... Maybe I got a little tired. My 
legs got all tangled up.
choice_data_list: First, let's get some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The challenge for the final jewel, the 
Kikuka Sho, begins right here!"
